lines.text: Bubble wrap was supposed to be wallpaper.
And before it found its real job, it failed twice.
In nineteen fifty-seven, two inventors sealed two shower curtains together, trapping air bubbles, to make a textured wallpaper.
lines.caption: In 1957, two inventors sealed two shower curtains together, trapping air bubbles, to make a textured wallpaper.

lines.text: As wallpaper, it never caught on.
So they tried selling it as greenhouse insulation. That didn't work well either.
Then IBM needed a way to ship its new computer without breaking it. Bubble wrap did the job, and the rest is history.
